items.title: DevFest Enugu 2026
items.text:
Date: 4 December 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 5 December 2026, 15:00 UTC
Location: Hotel Sylvia, Independence Avenue, Enugu
Registration: External registration

Welcome to DevFest Enugu 2026!

This 4–5 December, GDG Enugu is turning up the energy as we bring back our two-day, two-location DevFest!

We are continuing our mission to bring the magic of DevFest directly to you, hosting the event in both Enugu City and Nsukka to make it incredibly easy for builders and creators in both cities to connect without the hassle of travel.

We are bringing 1,300+ innovators, creators, and changemakers together to learn, build, and connect.

The Lineup

-

Day One | 4 Dec — Nsukka & Enugu (Two Cities, One Community)
We are splitting the map once again to bring the action straight to your doorstep! Join us for parallel, hands-on workshops, codelabs, and product demos happening simultaneously in both Enugu and Nsukka. Whether you're diving into Android, AI, Web, Web3, design thinking, or operational excellence, you can experience it all locally.

Nsukka venue: Blockhive Hub, Nsukka.

Enugu venue: Blockchain Hub Africa, Enugu.

-

Day Two | 5 Dec — Enugu City (The Grand Gathering)
Everyone converges! The main stage in Enugu City comes alive with high-energy keynotes, lightning talks, panels, fireside chats, and exhibitions where big ideas meet real impact and connections turn into collaborations.

Enugu venue: Hotel Sylvia, Enugu.
